title: FinA: Fairness of Adverse Effects in Decision-Making of Human-Cyber-Physical-System
reasoning: The paper focuses on formalizing fairness and equity metrics for control actions within Human-Cyber-Physical Systems (HCPS), specifically applied to smart home HVAC systems. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or specific moral or ethical frameworks as a primary component, nor does it relate to Large Language Models.
